assets.rationale: NVIDIA is one of the clearest company-level expressions of the AI infrastructure narrative.
Microsoft adds a cloud, software, and OpenAI-partnership angle to the AI / Tech Growth narrative, distinct from NVIDIA's chip-focused position.
QQQ provides broad exposure to large-cap growth and technology companies connected to the AI-led narrative.
Falling volatility is consistent with confidence in growth-oriented narratives; rising volatility can pressure them.
Exxon Mobil is a large integrated producer that provides a liquid, widely recognized Energy narrative proxy.
Chevron adds a second integrated-major observation for breadth and robustness, reducing reliance on a single company's movement.
SLB provides an oilfield-services and investment-cycle view, a distinct value-chain position from integrated producers.
Rising volatility is a direct market expression of broad macro pressure.
Dollar strength can reflect tighter global financial conditions and defensive demand.
TLT provides a direct long-duration rates observation, distinct from volatility and currency measures of Macro Pressure.
HYG provides a credit-risk and spread observation, a distinct dimension from TLT's duration exposure.
Growth-sensitive equities can face pressure as macro and financial conditions tighten.
AI market leadership can weaken when broad macro pressure constrains growth-sensitive assets.
